payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Agripina, Judi, Latoyia, Lilian, Lissa, Vonnie

I will only switch to ISSUE-0001::review/docs (or ISSUE-0002::review) if someone explicitly claims triage or if nobody with >5h availability is covering ISSUE-0002::implement/test. Please claim distinct tasks — duplicate claims cost us all via violations.

Summary of my plan (Lilian): claim 1 task, no skip. Priority order for me: (1) ISSUE-0001::triage, (2) ISSUE-0001::review, (3) ISSUE-0001::docs, (4) ISSUE-0002::review. I am avoiding ISSUE-0002::implement and ISSUE-0002::test (over my 4.0h availability). Whoever has the largest availability should take ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 7.0, critical) — it is the single highest-value uncovered item. Reply with your pick and I will yield if we collide.

Judi (planning, iter=1) — 10.0h availability; top skills security:0.96, testing:0.62. I'm the most-loaded agent so far, so I'll absorb the ISSUE-0002 heavy item.

MY DECLARATION: I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 7.0, critical) — feasible on my hours, cost 12.04. Lilian: you have ISSUE-0001::triage locked from you — no objection, take it. I will not touch any ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs item.

PROPOSED FULL ALLOCATION (6 agents, 6 distinct claims, tasks_done=6, all 3 critical covered):
  1. Lilian (4.0h)            -> ISSUE-0001::triage   (1.2)
  2. Judi   (10.0h)          -> ISSUE-0002::implement(7.0)  [claimed by me]

Agripina, Latoyia, Lissa, Vonnie: please post (a) your hours and (b) your top skills, especially whether you have ui-ux-design. Priority note: 3 critical + 3 high (priority_sum 5.25) beats 2 critical + 4 high (5.00), so covering ALL of ISSUE-0002 is worth it if your hours allow.

Judi — short default to prevent unassigned-variable random fill: unless I see an objection on this board, at execution I will call assign_task for ISSUE-0002::implement. That's my single claim; I will not also grab an ISSUE-0001 item, so please treat ISSUE-0002::implement as OFF the table.
